source: Gao J., Shi N., Li Y., Jiang B., Marhaba T., Zhang W., Environ. Sci. Technol. 56 (2022) 11602-11613, doi 10.1021/acs.est.1c08442; Fig. 2a (main PDF page 6)
summary: Independent marker re-read agrees within 0.05 mM (about 1 px). Calibration, series identity, times, units and the text rate constant check out. Flags are documentation-level only (the conditions.notes boilerplate). No values changed.
method: Verifier scripts: literature/extraction_scripts/gao_verify_a/markers2a.py and overlay2a.py, written independently of the extractor's scripts.

per_point.note: t=0 marker hidden/overlapped; pinned to c0

checks.detail: Fig. 2a from main PDF page 6 (PNG xref 388, 2092x997 px), extracted with pymupdf. The verifier located the y ticks itself: 6 at y = 66.41/130.41/194.48/258.45/322.57/386.55 px for 25..0 mM, 0.0781 mM/px, max residual 0.003 mM. It also located 7 x ticks (0-120 min), max residual 0.08 min. The plot frame spans -2.5 to 27.5 mM.

Series: purple open circles 'CuO-coated Cu foam'. Markers were segmented by HSV hue/chroma (the shaded error bands are low-chroma and drop out) and reduced to connected-component centroids; legend symbols were excluded. Max |stored - verifier| = 0.050 mM (0.20% of the 0-25 mM labelled span, 0.17% of the full -2.5..27.5 frame). The t = 0 markers of all three series overlap, so t = 0 is pinned to 25. Viewed overlay: stored crosses sit on the marker centres.

Legend: green triangle 'Cu foam/PTFE membrane', purple open circle 'CuO-coated Cu foam', orange filled circle 'CuO-coated Cu foam/PTFE membrane'. The text says the no-membrane case 'removed the trap chamber or ammonia stripping'; SI Fig. S2c says the PTFE was 'replaced with a non-permeable panel'.
Markers at 0, 20, ..., 120 min; the verifier's marker x positions fall within 0.06 min of the ticks.
Axis 'N-NO3- concentration (mM)': nitrate as N, factor 1.0. Correct.

Fig. 2 caption: -2 V vs SCE without ohmic compensation, initial NO3- 25 mM, pH ~7.0, Cl- 10 mM, other conditions as section 2.4 (0.5 M Na2SO4, 50 mL/min). Cu foam was pretreated in 3 M HCl for 10 min (section 2.1).

checks.check: pseudo-first-order k vs text kap 0.021 min-1
checks.detail: ln(C0/C) vs t through the origin on the stored points gives 0.0198 min-1 (free fit 0.0209).
Single-species dataset (NO3- only); no reported_n_loss; flag single_species_only present.

issues: The 20-min ring is partly hidden behind the orange marker. The verifier reconstructed it as top edge + (median unoccluded ring height - 1)/2, giving 17.886 mM vs stored 17.836: 0.05 mM, inside the extractor's stated +/-0.15.

Documentation: conditions.notes begins 'Three-chamber flow cell: trap | CuO@Cu-foam/PTFE cathode membrane | ...' and quotes the CuO/PTFE run's pH, current and trap pH, but this configuration replaced the PTFE membrane with a non-permeable panel (SI Fig. S2c; the catalyst field and the last sentence of the notes say so). Fig. S2c still shows the trap chamber, so the trap-loop recirculation in 'stirring' is plausible but not stated. Suggest rewording the notes.

fixes_applied.change: meta.json conditions.notes rewritten for this run: describes the CuO-coated Cu foam with the PTFE membrane replaced by a non-permeable panel (no longer 'CuO@Cu-foam/PTFE cathode membrane'), notes the text/Fig. S2c difference on the trap chamber and that the trap/anode-loop recirculation under stirring is assumed, states that current, in-run pH and NO2-/TAN data are not reported, and attributes the ~50 mA cm-2 (0.204 A) and pH 12.65 / 1.53 values to the Fig. 2e run. data/real regenerated (conditions.notes only; series unchanged). 20-min ring reconstruction: no change, as recorded.

agent_overlay_checked_flag: NOT ADDED. The converter copies meta.json 'flags' into quality.flags, and schema/dataset.schema.json restricts quality.flags to an enum (unobserved_sink_suspected, noisy, sparse, single_species_only, units_unverified, potential_unverified). Adding 'agent_overlay_checked' and regenerating makes data/real/<slug>.json fail errors('dataset', ...) and tests/test_schemas.py (checked by dry run, nothing written). Needs a decision by the lead: extend the enum (one line in the schema) or record the status elsewhere. data/real/<slug>.json is already byte-identical to what the converter builds from the current meta.json, so no regeneration is needed for the values.
